## SECURITIESAND FUTURES COMMISSION 證券及期貨事務察委員会

30 December 2011

## Circular to Licensed Corporations in relation to the proposed reporting of OTC derivatives transactions to the Hong Kong trade repository - Administration and Interface Development Guide for the Hong Kong trade repository

The  Hong  Kong  Monetary  Authority  ( HKMA )  is  in  the  process  of  developing  a  trade repository  ( HKTR )  in  support  of  the  proposed  regulatory  regime  for  Hong  Kong's  OTC derivatives market 1 .

The HKMA has today issued an Administration and Interface Development Guide ( the Guide ) which  will  assist  the  industry  in  planning  for  system  changes  in  relation  to  the  proposed reporting  of  OTC  derivatives  transactions  to  the  HKTR.  The  Guide  sets  out  the  technical standards  and  requirements  for  connecting  and  reporting  to  the  HKTR,  including  the templates for data submission. The Guide and the HKMA's letter dated 30 December 2011 are attached to this circular.

Subject to further progress of the regulatory framework, HKMA targets to issue within the first quarter  of  2012,  a  detailed  plan  for  system  testing,  and  detailed  rules  and  procedures  for reporting of OTC derivatives transactions to the HKTR; and connectivity tests are tentatively scheduled for the third quarter of 2012.

We urge all affected Licensed Corporations to plan ahead for any necessary system changes. Should you have any queries regarding the above, please contact the  HKMA  at hktr@hkma.gov.hk.

## Supervision of Markets Division Securities and Futures Commission

Encl.

1 On 29 July 2011, the HKMA issued a consultation paper to seek comments on certain logistical and technical matters relating to the HKTR. The HKMA published a report on 8 November 2011 which sets out the key comments it received and HKMA's responses and conclusions.
